info.title: AfterLedger API
info.description: Finds what a person left behind and prepares every claim, in any country. Every family, bank and paper in the demo is fictional; the rules are real.

schema.title: Response Demo Families V1 Demo Families Get
Response Demo Status V1 Demo Status Get

post.description:
Puts a sample family back as the image built it. Where sign-in is required only the admin may: the samples
are shared by every visitor, and may hold a live run's work.

schema.title: Response Demo Reset V1 Demo  Key  Reset Post

get.description: Replays the family's story from the first paper, with a pause after each event, as server-sent events.

schema.title: Response List Accounts V1 Admin Users Get

get.description:
Where sign-in is required (AL_AUTH): the sample cases and the signed-in account's own. Otherwise, every case
on a development copy; on a public site without accounts, the sample cases and the ones named in `ids`
(comma-separated: the cases this browser started or opened). A case's id is random: its private address.

schema.title: Response List Cases V1 Cases Get
Response Delete Case V1 Cases  Case Id  Delete
Response Upload V1 Cases  Case Id  Papers Post

post.description: The family answers "did they have…?" for something families in this country usually hold.

schema.title: Response Prepare Pack V1 Cases  Case Id  Claims  Claim Id  Pack Post

get.description: Activity lines and 'something changed' notices for open screens, as server-sent events.

schema.title: Response Checkpoints V1 Cases  Case Id  Checkpoints Get
Response List Presets V1 Challenges Presets Get
Response List Challenges V1 Challenges Get

get.description:
Every step of the run as it happens. Steps already done are replayed first, `pace` seconds apart, and
each step's words come in the page's language (`lang`, since an event stream cannot set headers).

schema.title: Response Save As Case V1 Challenges  Run Id  Case Post

post.description: The institution records that it has paid. The family sees it at once.

The institution asks for something else. It reaches the family as a reply, read against the rules, so a
request the rules do not allow is shown beside the paragraph it conflicts with.

get.description: The latest evaluation report, or an empty one that says how to make it, in the page's language.

post.description: Runs the evaluation in a separate process, so the service keeps answering while it works.

schema.title: Response Run V1 Eval Run Post

get.description:
Model use: each case's total from its activity (it survives a restart), and each agent's and model's since
this copy of the service started. Costs are estimates from data/knowledge/prices.yaml. Not on the public site:
it names every case.

AnswerIn.title: AnswerIn
AnswerIn.description: An answer to any checkpoint (C1-C7): the option's value, plus a corrected value or a note.

CalibrationInfo.title: CalibrationInfo
CalibrationInfo.description: Where the certainty labels come from: the hand-set starting tables, or tables refitted on live cases.

asked_by.title: Asked By
asked_by.description: Who asks and from where, in the question's language

title.title: Title
title.description: A short title in the question's language

translation.title: Translation
translation.description: The question in English, when known

CiteView.title: CiteView
CiteView.description: One rule, in its source's own words, for every Why? on every screen.

event.title: Event
event.description: submitted, complete_set_confirmed, settled, returned, or any plan event name

rule.title: Rule
rule.description: The rule or paragraph the institution relies on

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: The amount paid, as a decimal

HealthInfo.title: HealthInfo
HealthInfo.description:
Which live services answered since the service started, and which failed. A failure falls back to the
offline stand-in (and says so here) unless the run is strict, when it stops the work instead. Slow model
endpoints are listed apart: their calls were answered by the same model elsewhere, so nothing failed.

RowView.title: RowView
RowView.description: A line of a statement or passbook, as the evidence behind a lead, a payee or a value.

SlowRoute.title: SlowRoute
SlowRoute.description:
A model endpoint ("gemini-3.8-flash", "gemini-3.8-flash@us") that was slow or overloaded: its calls went to the
same model on another endpoint, and it is passed over for a while (passed_over: it still is).

TodayNote.title: TodayNote
TodayNote.description: One family member's greeting for the day, in English and in their own language.

UsageReport.title: UsageReport
UsageReport.description:
What the models were used for: each case's total (kept with its activity, so it survives a restart), and
each agent's and model's since this copy of the service started.

UsageView.title: UsageView
UsageView.description: Model calls and their tokens; the cost is an estimate from the price table in data/knowledge/prices.yaml.
